source_or_gap: Eight worked examples and six shorter comparisons with reader counterparts.
chapter_action_policy: Eight worked examples and six short comparisons in both editions. Six other papers retained as research leads in the manuscript review.
boundary_decision_rationale: Each study changes the interpretation of an existing decision or measurement.
external_literature_need: Retained leads from the November 18 screen: optimizer-state staleness (2603.16731v2), prefix-normalized policy optimization (2608.01418v1), adaptive targeted dynamic chunking (2605.30080v1), trajectory-based data influence (2608.13515v1), prospective data curation (2611.19698v1), and information disclosure in agent markets (2611.07667v1). Candidate uses and limits are recorded in docs/reader_manuscript_review.md.
proof_or_test_backlog: Adoption requires a comparison under the intended load, budget, user population or update schedule.
evidence_transition_precondition: Adoption or stronger capability claims require the appropriate matched comparison and an accepted evidence transition.
required_before_drafting: Review the primary passage and the comparison limits before using the result.
promotion_blockers: Results describe the cited setups, including the declared measurement and population.
residuals: This conditional rate alone leaves the frequency of joint failures and the accuracy of consensus unspecified. Task mixture and shared dependencies matter.
Replication supported the direction of damage more consistently than its magnitude. The exact oracle depends on executable rules.
Predicted episodes can expose errors in the simulator. Physical control needs separate closed-loop evidence.
Equality under a local first-order map is a mathematical condition. Finite interventions and new prompt distributions require behavioral checks.
The tasks differ in output length and maximum feasible batch size. GPU energy excludes other facility loads and cannot by itself determine emissions.
The study used one 12-layer model, top-2 and top-6 routing and 2.1B training tokens. Gains depend on traffic, layout and load.
Observed interaction styles were not randomized treatments. A short study cannot estimate lasting workforce effects.
The simulations are noiseless, batch limits differed, symbolic gains varied, and random acquisition was competitive with disagreement scoring.
All inputs were text-normalized. Dataset and context differences limit comparisons across source modalities.
Selection of the observed top ten and the choice of interval affect inference. An unresolved difference leaves equivalence open.
Bits per byte and downstream scores describe those configurations. A boundary score does not certify semantic fidelity on a new language or task.
The smaller decoder changes the output behavior. Quality, transfer costs and request latency need comparison on the same prompt mix.
New allocations apply to newly quantized blocks. Aggregate accuracy and memory depend on the agents, workload and model.
Results varied by model and task. Count work completed, adverse outcomes and total inference spent together.
next_action: Revisit cited results when their benchmark or manuscript changes.
non_claims: Worked examples are editorial applications. Published results provide contextual evidence.
